en.title: The Sunlit Kitchen and a Corner of Rusted Memories
en.premise: After more than a decade of estrangement from her father, Shiori returns to her childhood home to clear out her family's belongings. The long silence between her and her awkward father is slowly filled by a recipe book left behind by her late mother and the simple meals they prepare together. With every meal shared at the table, the family's frozen time begins to move once more, ever so slowly.

zh.title: 暖阳厨房与锈蚀记忆的一隅
zh.premise: 与父亲疏远了十余年，女儿栞为了整理旧宅而回到了家乡。在与笨拙的父亲之间，那漫长的沉默被亡母留下的食谱以及两人共同烹饪的简单料理所填补。每当围坐在餐桌旁，那停滞不前的家族时光便会再次缓缓流动起来。
